_comment: Copy to config/mcp-gateway.json (gitignored) and adjust. Each upstream is a stdio MCP server the gateway spawns and exposes as <name>__<tool>. write_tools, destructive_tools and open_world_tools set the MCP tool annotations clients use for approval prompts.

papers._comment: The paper library: https://github.com/polarizetech/paper-fetch. Install it with its [mcp] extra so that paper-fetch-mcp is on PATH, or give an absolute path.

pipeline._comment: The full pipeline as start/continue tools. By default the calling model answers its model steps (PIPELINE_MCP_LLM=client). Give an absolute path if research-pipeline-mcp is not on PATH.

companions._comment: Tools the pipeline may loop in when a question calls for one (research_pipeline/companions.py). They are not offered to MCP clients through the gateway; the pipeline spawns them itself, only when the planner requests one. Set enabled to true once the command is installed.

datasets._comment: dataset-fetch: discovery over open research datasets. Adds a 'Datasets that could test this' section, listed from the catalogues' own records.

patents._comment: patent-fetch: finds existing patents (https://github.com/polarizetech/patent-fetch). It ships a command line, not an MCP server, so the pipeline runs `patent-fetch --json search ...`. Adds an 'Existing patents on this' section from the patent services' own records. Without an EPO OPS key it can only search life-science patents up to 2012, and the answer says so.

web_search._comment: Optional SearXNG base URL for web__search. SEARXNG_URL in the environment overrides it.

network._comment: Host headers accepted in addition to loopback, for a front end that presents a different Host (e.g. a Docker bridge). The bind itself stays on 127.0.0.1.
